caption: The drawing consists of a grid of square blocks arranged in a 7 by 9 pattern, with one block space missing from the central area of the grid, creating a large rectangular gap. Each square block contains a geometric design: a white diamond with numbers or letters inside (written in black ink), surrounded by a red circular border. Within each red circle, four small bow-like shapes appear at the cardinal points, and the corners of the squares are filled with green triangles. The grid is labeled along the top and left edges with numbers and lowercase letters, respectively. The bottom of the image includes the typed text "KEY TO PATTERNS," and the bottom right corner has additional text reading "STENCIL AND QUILTS." The entire composition is hand-drawn and colored, with clear use of green, red, and black against an off-white background.
title: Quilt
